title: デビュー戦の後に・新緑の旨味

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ngh… I grossly underestimated how emotional it would be running with everyone and seeing the race up close and personal!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Still! No matter how overwhelming today's race was, it hasn't quenched my thirst to see Umas running on dirt… So, you know what that means!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Next up is the Hyacinth Stakes at the beginning of next year! Until then, it's grind, grind, grind!
